rules: The approved master banner is the immutable visual source of truth; do not redesign or reinterpret it.
Every visible control must map to a verified GUI component and, where applicable, a real APVTS parameter ID.
Do not create a visual control for an APVTS parameter unless its UI role and interaction are explicitly implemented.
Keep existing APVTS IDs, DSP, processor state, MIDI scheduling and audio-thread behavior unchanged.
Asset references describe intended visual use; they do not claim that SVG assets are already loaded by the native editor.
